heading: Rajinikanth’s ‘Dharman’ gears up for intense action sequence; director Ashwath Marimuthu shares update
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in /  Sep 21, 2026, 11:33 IST
paragraphs: Director Ashwath Marimuthu is working with superstar Rajinikanth on his upcoming thrilling family drama ‘Dharman’
The film is currently in the production phase and recently the director has now shared a new update from the sets

He teased the team is gearing up for an action sequence.Director teases an action scene in the makingTaking to X, Ashwath shared a picture of National Award-winning stunt choreographers Anbariv working on the sets

He wrote, “@anbariv masters at work (fire symbol) #dharman.” The update has hinted that the team is preparing for an intense action scene.Makers share BTS from second and third sequencesThe team began the third schedule of ‘Dharman’ on September 16
Ashwath had earlier shared a BTS clip featuring Rajinikanth and Raashi Khanna shooting for the film
The clip showed Rajinikanth seated with his back facing the camera while having a conversation with Raashi Khanna.The second schedule of the film was completed on September 4

The makers shared a video from the sets which showed Rajinikanth playing a senior medical faculty member and lecturing junior doctors.Rajinikanth in ‘Dharman’Talking about Rajinikanth’s character in ‘Dharman’, he will play a doctor who takes on criminals

The makers had earlier released a title poster showing the Superstar inside an operation theatre, holding a scalpel and standing over what appeared to be a slain rowdy sheeter.Speaking about the team, it stars Raashi Khanna in an important role and has music by Anirudh Ravichander

Niketh Bommi is handling cinematography, while Pradeep E Raghav is the editor.The film is produced by Tamil veteran Kamal Haasan backed under his banner.Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth’s upcoming filmsInterestingly, Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth after ‘Dharman’ are reuniting for another project
Fortunately, for fans Kamal Haasan won’t only be backing the film but will also join as a lead

The film is tentatively titled ‘KHxRK’.Meanwhile, Rajinikanth will be next seen in the much awaited sequel, ‘Jailer 2’, directed by Nelson Dilipkumar.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more
